title: Find Maximum Balanced XOR Subarray Length
summary: Given an integer array, determine the longest subarray with a bitwise XOR of zero and an equal count of even and odd numbers.
statement: Given an integer array, determine the longest subarray with a bitwise XOR of zero and an equal count of even and odd numbers. If no such subarray is found, return zero.
constraints: nums contains up to 100,000 nonnegative integers.
A qualifying subarray has XOR zero and equal counts of even and odd values.
Return its maximum length, or zero when none exists.
hints: A subarray XOR is zero when its endpoint prefix XORs match.
Its parity counts match when the endpoint even-minus-odd prefix balances also match.
Store the earliest index for every pair (prefix XOR, balance) and maximize distance on repeats.
Equality of both prefix components is exactly the two required subarray conditions, and the earliest match gives the longest span.
editorial: Equality of both prefix components is exactly the two required subarray conditions, and the earliest match gives the longest span.

tests.explanation: The subarray [1,3,2,0] has XOR zero and two values of each parity.
The full array has XOR zero and four values of each parity.
